questions.question: Which device operates at the Physical layer and simply repeats signals?
questions.explanation: A hub operates at the Physical layer and broadcasts signals to all connected devices.

questions.question: Which device operates at the Data Link layer and uses MAC addresses?
questions.explanation: A switch operates at the Data Link layer and forwards frames based on MAC addresses.

questions.question: Which device operates at the Network layer and connects different networks?
questions.explanation: A router operates at the Network layer and routes packets between different networks using IP addresses.

questions.question: Which device connects a computer to a network?
questions.explanation: A Network Interface Card connects a computer to a network and provides a physical interface.

questions.question: Which device converts digital signals to analog and vice versa?
questions.explanation: A modem modulates and demodulates signals for transmission over telephone or cable lines.

questions.question: Which device provides wireless network connectivity?
questions.explanation: A wireless access point allows wireless devices to connect to a wired network.

questions.question: Which device filters network traffic based on security rules?
questions.explanation: A firewall monitors and controls network traffic based on predefined security rules.

questions.question: Which device connects two similar network segments at the Data Link layer?
questions.explanation: A bridge connects network segments and filters traffic based on MAC addresses.

questions.question: Which device translates between different network protocols?
questions.explanation: A gateway operates at multiple layers and translates between different protocol architectures.

questions.question: Which device amplifies and regenerates signals over long distances?
questions.explanation: A repeater regenerates weakened signals to extend network range without amplifying noise.

questions.question: Which device prevents broadcast traffic from crossing between network segments?
questions.explanation: Routers create separate broadcast domains and do not forward broadcast packets between routed networks.

questions.question: Which device caches frequently requested web content to reduce bandwidth usage?
questions.explanation: A proxy server caches web content and serves repeated requests locally, saving bandwidth.

questions.question: Which device distributes incoming client requests across multiple servers?
questions.explanation: A load balancer spreads traffic across servers to improve performance and availability.

questions.question: What switch feature supplies electrical power to devices like IP phones over Ethernet cables?
questions.explanation: Power over Ethernet (PoE) delivers electrical power alongside data on twisted-pair cabling.

questions.question: Which device operates at both Layer 2 and Layer 3 to perform routing within a LAN?
questions.explanation: A multilayer switch combines switching and routing functions using hardware ASICs.

questions.question: Which device converts signals between different media types such as copper and fiber optic?
questions.explanation: A media converter translates between copper Ethernet and fiber optic cabling.

questions.question: Which device terminates and organizes horizontal cabling runs in a wiring closet?
questions.explanation: A patch panel provides a central termination point that keeps cable runs organized.

questions.question: Which device inspects network traffic and can actively block malicious packets in real time?
questions.explanation: An Intrusion Prevention System sits inline and blocks detected threats, unlike a passive IDS.

questions.question: Which security appliance combines firewall, antivirus, and intrusion prevention in one device?
questions.explanation: A Unified Threat Management (UTM) device consolidates multiple security functions.

questions.question: Which device terminates VPN tunnels to provide remote users access to a private network?
questions.explanation: A VPN concentrator is purpose-built to handle many simultaneous encrypted VPN connections.

questions.question: Which device serves as the exit point for traffic leaving a local network toward external networks?
questions.explanation: The default gateway forwards packets destined for networks outside the local subnet.

questions.question: Which device is required to route traffic between different VLANs?
questions.explanation: Inter-VLAN routing requires a Layer 3 device such as a router or Layer 3 switch.

questions.question: Which device connects two wired network segments over a wireless link?
questions.explanation: A wireless bridge joins two wired LAN segments using a wireless connection.

questions.question: Which device provides centralized management and authentication for multiple access points?
questions.explanation: A Wireless LAN Controller manages configuration, security, and roaming for enterprise access points.

questions.question: Which device receives and queues print jobs from clients before sending them to a printer?
questions.explanation: A print server manages print queues and job delivery to shared printers.

questions.question: Which device connects LAN equipment to a digital leased line such as a T1 circuit?
questions.explanation: A CSU/DSU terminates digital circuits like T1/T3 lines between the LAN and the provider.

questions.question: Sixteen PCs are connected to a single 16-port Ethernet hub. How many collision domains exist in this network?
questions.explanation: A hub repeats all signals to every port, so the entire hub is a single collision domain; each switch port would create its own.

questions.question: A switch receives a unicast frame whose destination MAC address is not in its MAC table. What does it do?
options: Floods the frame out all ports except the one it arrived on
Sends the frame to its default gateway
Buffers the frame until the MAC is learned
questions.explanation: Unknown unicast frames are flooded to all ports except the ingress port so the destination can respond and be learned.

questions.question: A company adds a guest VLAN that must reach the Internet but must be blocked from internal servers. Which device should enforce this policy?
questions.explanation: Inter-VLAN traffic requires Layer 3 forwarding, and access control lists on a router or firewall restrict which subnets guests can reach.

questions.question: Two switches are connected with two parallel patch cables and broadcasts begin looping endlessly. Which protocol would have blocked the redundant link?
questions.explanation: STP (802.1D) detects loops and places redundant ports in a blocking state, preventing broadcast storms.

questions.question: A packet capture shows a device rewriting the source address of outbound packets from 192.168.1.10 to a public IP. Which device function is operating?
questions.explanation: NAT translates private source addresses into a public address on outbound packets, typically on a router or firewall.
